description:
After being chased by bandits and losing some valuable packages, postman Philip turns to his new friends, Jack and Jill, for help in delivering all the remaining packages to their rightful owners. 
But it's not just a simple delivery task - the bandits are still on the loose and willing to do whatever it takes to get their hands on the rare and valuable packages.

- Enjoy animated 2D cutscenes
- Complete 45 levels within the time limit 
- Earn dozens of achievements 
- Plan your way to victory with simple mouse clicks 
- Deliver packages to people in 5 mini-game levels
name: Golden Rails: Valuable Package Collector's Edition
intro: An exciting new adventure in the world of mail delivery!
